Why go: the largest private yacht you can charter around Samui

At 41 m, Ocean Emerald is in a different class from the day boats that work out of Samui. It has a crew of nine, two 1,400 hp engines, a 14-knot cruising speed and accommodation for 12 guests overnight. By day it can host events of up to 40. Routes are built to order: Ang Thong's islands (from 16 December), Koh Phangan's north coast, Koh Tao, or a week moving slowly through the Gulf.

The base price covers the yacht and crew. Fuel, food and drinks are charged on top, as is normal for superyacht charters. That is why this charter is enquiry-only: we build a full quote around your route, guest numbers and menu before anything is paid.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: family offices, milestone celebrations, corporate events and groups who want to live on board for a few days.
  • Choose something else if: you want a single luxury day. A Sunseeker 60 day charter or a large sailing catamaran gives most of the experience for a fraction of the cost.

Good to know

  • Location: the yacht also works from Phuket, Pattaya and Koh Phangan. If it isn't on Samui for your dates, a repositioning fee applies.
  • Season: February to September gives the calmest seas and the widest choice of anchorages.
  • Lead time: enquire at least 4–6 weeks ahead for December to April dates.
  • Provisioning: send dietary needs and drinks preferences early, so the crew can stock the yacht before you board.
  • Paperwork: passport details for every guest are needed for the crew and passenger list before departure.
